xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DeclarationOfUnmodifiedOpinion: Statement on impact of audit qualification
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:AuditorsFirmName: M/s Sharp Aarth and Co. LLP
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DetailsOfAuditQualificationExp: The audit qualification pertains to certain non-compliances under the Foreign Exchange Management Act (FEMA), 1999 and the External Commercial Borrowings (ECB) framework in relation to the issuance of Foreign Currency Convertible Bonds (FCCBs), including deviations in end-use of funds and delays in regulatory filings. The Company has initiated corrective actions by remitting the Late Submission Fee (LSF), applying for modification of the Loan Registration Number (LRN), and proposing to file the requisite forms with the Reserve Bank of India (RBI). The matter is under regularisation with the RBI, and the financial implications, if any, will be determined upon completion of the regulatory process.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:ReasonsIfManagementIsUnableToE: The audit qualifications will be resolved upon completion of the required compliances, as the qualifications have arisen due to pending compliance matters.
